Extensions.Title: Extensions
Extensions.Subtitle: Give the agent new tools and know-how: MCP servers, skills, plugins and slash commands.
Extensions.Mcp.Title: MCP servers
Extensions.Mcp.Caption: Same format as Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Cursor. Tools appear as mcp__server__tool.
Extensions.Mcp.Empty: No servers yet. Open mcp.json, paste a server under mcpServers, then press Reload. Use ${secret:NAME} or ${env:NAME} for keys.
Extensions.Plugins.Title: Plugins
Extensions.Plugins.Caption: Claude Code plugins work as they are: skills, commands and MCP servers in one folder.
Extensions.Plugins.SourcePlaceholder: Folder, https git URL or owner/repo (a marketplace installs all its plugins, turned off)
Extensions.Skills.Title: Skills
Extensions.Skills.Caption: Folders with a SKILL.md. The agent sees each name and description, and loads the instructions only when a task needs them.
Extensions.Skills.Empty: No skills yet. Install one above, or add .kam/skills or .claude/skills to your workspace.
Extensions.Commands.Title: Slash commands
Extensions.Commands.Caption: Markdown prompts you run from chat. $ARGUMENTS is replaced with what you type after the command.
Extensions.Commands.Empty: No commands yet. Save a .md file in the commands folder; review.md becomes /review.
Extensions.Message.ConnectedWithFailures: {0} available. {1} failed to start; see the error below it.
Extensions.Message.Reloaded: Reloaded mcp.json. Servers start on the next chat turn.
Extensions.Message.EditMcpConfig: Edit mcp.json, save it, then press Reload.
Extensions.Message.EnterPluginSource: Enter a plugin folder, a git URL or owner/repo.
Extensions.Message.PluginOn: Turned on {0}. Its skills, commands and servers are available from the next message.
Extensions.Message.EnterSkillSource: Enter a folder that contains SKILL.md.
Extensions.Message.SkillInstalled: Installed the {0} skill. The agent can use it from the next message.
